add-semi-transparent-logo-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Semi-Transparent Logo Stamp to First PDF Page
add-semi-transparent-logo-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating an ImageStamp from a PNG logo, setting its opacity for semi-transparency, positioning it on the first page, and saving the modified document.

add-image-stamp-to-pdf-page.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF Page with Quality and Opacity
add-image-stamp-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, setting the stamp's image quality to 100 % and opacity to 80 %. The example also includes basic file existence checks and saves the modified document.

add-image-stamp-with-alt-text-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Image Stamp with Alt Text to PDF Page 3
add-image-stamp-with-alt-text-to-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on the third page of a PDF and assign alternative text to the image for accessibility using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Apply Image Stamp to All PDF Pages
apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp, and apply it to every page using a foreach loop before saving the modified document.

add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf.title: Rotate Image Stamp 45° and Add to PDF
add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to rotate an image stamp by 45 degrees and place it centered on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

align-image-stamp-top-right-margin.title: Align Image Stamp to Top‑Right Corner with Margins
align-image-stamp-top-right-margin.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp in the top‑right corner of each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, with configurable right and top margins.

scale-image-stamp-full-page-width.title: Scale Image Stamp to Full Page Width in PDF
scale-image-stamp-full-page-width.description: Demonstrates how to add an image stamp to each page of a PDF, scaling it to the page width while preserving the image's aspect ratio.

add-image-stamp-from-memory-stream-to-pd.title: Add Image Stamp from Memory Stream to PDF
add-image-stamp-from-memory-stream-to-pd.description: Demonstrates how to load an image into a MemoryStream and apply it as an ImageStamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-low-quality-image-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Low‑Quality Image Stamp to PDF Pages
add-low-quality-image-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to apply a low‑quality (10 % JPEG) image stamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, which helps improve performance on large documents.

add-opaque-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Fully Opaque Image Stamp to PDF
add-opaque-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp with 100% opacity, and apply it as a centered watermark on every page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Diagonal Image Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to apply a rotated image stamp as a diagonal watermark on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-upside-down-image-stamp.title: Add Upside-Down Image Stamp to PDF Page
add-upside-down-image-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on a PDF page and rotate it 180 degrees so it appears upside‑down using Aspose.Pdf.

place-image-stamp-custom-coordinates.title: Place Image Stamp with Custom Coordinates
place-image-stamp-custom-coordinates.description: Shows how to add an image stamp to each page of a PDF at specific X and Y positions using Aspose.Pdf, with optional opacity and background settings.

add-image-stamp-percentage-position.title: Add Image Stamp with Percentage Offsets to PDF Pages
add-image-stamp-percentage-position.description: Shows how to place an image stamp on each page of a PDF using X and Y offsets expressed as percentages of the page width and height.

fit-image-stamp-within-rectangle.title: Fit Image Stamp Within a Rectangle in PDF
fit-image-stamp-within-rectangle.description: Demonstrates how to size and position an ImageStamp so that it exactly fits a defined rectangle on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-fixed-size-image-stamp-to-pdf-page.title: Apply Fixed-Size Image Stamp to PDF Pages
apply-fixed-size-image-stamp-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates adding an image stamp with a constant width and height to every page of a PDF, ignoring page size variations, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-unicode-alt-text.title: Add Image Stamp with Multilingual Alternative Text
add-image-stamp-unicode-alt-text.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on each page of a PDF and set Unicode alternative text for multilingual accessibility using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-alt-text-pdfa.title: Add Image Stamp with Alternative Text for PDF/A‑1b
add-image-stamp-alt-text-pdfa.description: Demonstrates stamping an image on each page, setting alternative text for accessibility, and converting the document to PDF/A‑1b compliance using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-encrypted-pdf.title: Add Image Stamp to Encrypted PDF
add-image-stamp-to-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF with a user password, decrypting it, applying an image stamp to each page, and saving the stamped document.

add-image-stamp-to-signed-pdf.title: Add Image Stamp to Signed PDF Without Invalidating Signature
add-image-stamp-to-signed-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on an existing digitally signed PDF using Aspose.Pdf while preserving the signature by performing an incremental update.

add-image-stamp-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF While Preserving Annotations
add-image-stamp-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp with transparency, applying it to every page, and saving the document while keeping existing annotations intact.

add-image-stamp-to-pdf-form.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF Form While Preserving Fields
add-image-stamp-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing form fields, place an image stamp on each page, and save the document so the form fields remain interactive.

add-image-stamp-flatten-annotations.title: Add Image Stamp and Flatten Annotations to Create Read‑Only PDF
add-image-stamp-flatten-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to stamp an image onto every page of a PDF and then flatten all annotations so the result becomes a read‑only document.

add-image-stamp-preserve-bookmarks.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving Bookmarks
add-image-stamp-preserve-bookmarks.description: Shows how to overlay an image stamp on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and keep the existing bookmarks/outlines unchanged.

add-image-stamp-preserve-page-labels.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF While Preserving Page Labels
add-image-stamp-preserve-page-labels.description: Demonstrates how to overlay an image stamp on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, keeping existing page labels intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-xmp-metadata.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving XMP Metadata
add-image-stamp-preserve-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, extracting its XMP metadata, applying an image stamp to every page, and then restoring the original metadata before saving the document.

add-image-stamp-preserve-embedded-files.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving Embedded Files
add-image-stamp-preserve-embedded-files.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF that contains embedded files, applying an image stamp to each page, and saving the document while keeping the original embedded attachments intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-javascript.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF While Preserving JavaScript Actions
add-image-stamp-preserve-javascript.description: The example loads an existing PDF, creates an ImageStamp from a PNG file, places it at the bottom‑right of each page, and saves the document while keeping any embedded JavaScript actions intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-acroform-fields.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving AcroForm Fields
add-image-stamp-preserve-acroform-fields.description: Shows how to apply an image stamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and keep the existing AcroForm fields editable.

add-custom-text-stamp-to-pdf-first-page.title: Add Blue Text Stamp to First PDF Page
add-custom-text-stamp-to-pdf-first-page.description: Demonstrates how to create a text stamp with a custom font, size, and blue color, and apply it only to the first page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-outlined-text-stamp.title: Add Outlined Text Stamp to PDF
add-outlined-text-stamp.description: Shows how to place a text stamp with stroke (outlined) rendering mode on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bold-outlined-text-stamp.title: Add Bold Outline Text Stamp to PDF
add-bold-outlined-text-stamp.description: Shows how to place a text stamp with a simulated bold outline on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bottom-left-text-stamp.title: Align Text Stamp to Bottom-Left Corner
add-bottom-left-text-stamp.description: Demonstrates adding a TextStamp to each page of a PDF and positioning it at the bottom‑left corner with a 10‑point margin using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rotated-text-watermark.title: Rotate Text Stamp for Slanted Watermark
add-rotated-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to create a text stamp, set its appearance, rotate it 30 degrees, and apply it as a slanted watermark to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-confidential-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Semi-Transparent Confidential Text Stamp to PDF
add-confidential-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a TextStamp with 0.6 opacity, and apply it to every page before saving the document.

add-text-stamp-with-background-box.title: Add Text Stamp with Background Box to PDF Pages
add-text-stamp-with-background-box.description: Shows how to place a centered, semi‑transparent text stamp with a colored background box on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-text-stamp.title: Add Multi-Line Disclaimer Text Stamp with Custom Line Spacing
add-multi-line-text-stamp.description: Shows how to place a multi-line disclaimer as a text stamp on every page of a PDF and adjust its line spacing using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rtl-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Right-to-Left Text Stamp to PDF
add-rtl-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to place a right‑to‑left language stamp (Arabic or Hebrew) on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf with a Unicode font.

add-full-page-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Full-Page Text Watermark to PDF
add-full-page-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to apply a semi‑transparent, diagonal text stamp that covers the entire page as a watermark using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-text-stamp-watermark.title: Add Diagonal Text Stamp Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-text-stamp-watermark.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a semi‑transparent TextStamp rotated 45°, configuring its appearance, and applying it to every page as a diagonal watermark.

add-background-image-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Background Image Stamp to PDF Page
add-background-image-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to place an image stamp behind the existing content of a PDF page by setting the Background property to true and aligning it to cover the page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-faint-overlay-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Faint Image Overlay to PDF Pages
add-faint-overlay-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to apply an image stamp with 40% opacity as a faint overlay on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rotated-text-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add 90° Rotated Image Stamp to PDF Pages
add-rotated-text-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp, rotating it 90 degrees, centering it on each page, and saving the stamped document.

add-custom-sized-page-stamp.title: Add Image Stamp with Custom Size to Specific PDF Page
add-custom-sized-page-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp with custom width and height on a chosen page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF Pages 5-10
add-page-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp, and apply it to a specific page range (pages 5 through 10) before saving the document.

add-global-text-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Stamp to All PDF Pages
add-global-text-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp, and apply it to every page using Page.AddStamp, then save the stamped document.

create-page-stamp-from-existing-pdf-page.title: Create Page Stamp from PDF Page and Apply to Document
create-page-stamp-from-existing-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to extract a page from a source PDF, create a PdfPageStamp from it, and apply that stamp to each page of a target PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-pdf-page-background-stamp.title: Apply PDF Page as Background Stamp
apply-pdf-page-background-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to render a page from one PDF to an image and use it as a background stamp for every page of another PDF document.
